us-20261010-news-1.title: Pembacaan Sentimen 48.1: Mengapa Orang Amerika Merasa Lebih Suram Daripada yang Disarankan Data

segments.src: When the University of Michigan released its final consumer sentiment reading for September, the headline number landed near 48.
segments.tr: When the University of Michigan released its final consumer sentiment reading for September, the headline number landed near 48.

segments.src: By historical standards, that is a very low reading, the kind of level more often associated with deep recessions or acute inflation shocks than with an economy that is still adding jobs and growing.
segments.tr: By historical standards, that is a very low reading, the kind of level more often associated with deep recessions or acute inflation shocks than with an economy that is still adding jobs and growing.

segments.src: The survey also showed year-ahead inflation expectations climbing toward 4.6%.
segments.tr: The survey also showed year-ahead inflation expectations climbing toward 4.6%.

segments.src: For many observers, the pairing raises an old question: why does the mood of American households so often diverge from the hard economic data?
segments.tr: For many observers, the pairing raises an old question: why does the mood of American households so often diverge from the hard economic data?

segments.src: And, just as importantly, why do central bankers pay such close attention to it?
segments.tr: And, just as importantly, why do central bankers pay such close attention to it?

segments.src: ## What the Index Actually Measures
segments.tr: ## What the Index Actually Measures

segments.src: The University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers asks a representative sample of households about their personal finances, their view of business conditions, and their buying plans.
segments.tr: The University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers asks a representative sample of households about their personal finances, their view of business conditions, and their buying plans.

segments.src: Respondents are also asked what they expect to happen to prices over the next year and over the next five to ten years.
segments.tr: Respondents are also asked what they expect to happen to prices over the next year and over the next five to ten years.

segments.src: Two points are worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: Two points are worth keeping in mind:

segments.src: - **It measures perception, not activity.** The index captures how people feel, not how much they are spending or earning.
segments.tr: - **It measures perception, not activity.** The index captures how people feel, not how much they are spending or earning.

segments.src: - **It is a diffusion-style index.** A reading near 48 does not mean "48% of people are unhappy." It reflects the balance of favorable and unfavorable answers, scaled against a baseline year.
segments.tr: - **It is a diffusion-style index.** A reading near 48 does not mean "48% of people are unhappy." It reflects the balance of favorable and unfavorable answers, scaled against a baseline year.

segments.src: ## Why Mood and Data Keep Pulling Apart
segments.tr: ## Why Mood and Data Keep Pulling Apart

segments.src: Economists have offered several explanations for the gap between sentiment and statistics.
segments.tr: Economists have offered several explanations for the gap between sentiment and statistics.

segments.src: None of them is complete on its own, but together they paint a useful picture.
segments.tr: None of them is complete on its own, but together they paint a useful picture.

segments.src: ### 1. Price levels matter more than inflation rates
segments.tr: ### 1. Price levels matter more than inflation rates

segments.src: Official statistics usually report the *rate* of inflation.
segments.tr: Official statistics usually report the *rate* of inflation.

segments.src: Households, however, experience the *level* of prices.
segments.tr: Households, however, experience the *level* of prices.

segments.src: Even if inflation cools, groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities may still cost far more than they did a few years ago.
segments.tr: Even if inflation cools, groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities may still cost far more than they did a few years ago.

segments.src: People tend to judge their well-being against what they remember paying, not against a rate of change.
segments.tr: People tend to judge their well-being against what they remember paying, not against a rate of change.

segments.src: ### 2. Frequent purchases shape perception
segments.tr: ### 2. Frequent purchases shape perception

segments.src: Gasoline, food, and other everyday items are bought often and are highly visible.
segments.tr: Gasoline, food, and other everyday items are bought often and are highly visible.

segments.src: Big-ticket price moves in these categories can color a household's overall view of the economy more than a broad price index does.
segments.tr: Big-ticket price moves in these categories can color a household's overall view of the economy more than a broad price index does.

segments.src: ### 3. Borrowing costs bite
segments.tr: ### 3. Borrowing costs bite

segments.src: Higher interest rates affect mortgages, auto loans, and credit cards.
segments.tr: Higher interest rates affect mortgages, auto loans, and credit cards.

segments.src: Someone who wants to buy a home or finance a car may feel squeezed even while the broader economy looks resilient.
segments.tr: Someone who wants to buy a home or finance a car may feel squeezed even while the broader economy looks resilient.

segments.src: That experience can weigh heavily on answers about "good times to buy."
segments.tr: That experience can weigh heavily on answers about "good times to buy."

segments.src: ### 4. Uneven experiences hide behind averages
segments.tr: ### 4. Uneven experiences hide behind averages

segments.src: Aggregate data can look healthy while particular groups, such as renters, younger workers, or lower-income households, face a different reality.
segments.tr: Aggregate data can look healthy while particular groups, such as renters, younger workers, or lower-income households, face a different reality.

segments.src: Sentiment surveys can pick up that unevenness in a way that headline employment or output figures do not.
segments.tr: Sentiment surveys can pick up that unevenness in a way that headline employment or output figures do not.

segments.src: ### 5. Information and political filters
segments.tr: ### 5. Information and political filters

segments.src: Research has consistently shown that views about the economy can vary with political affiliation, media consumption, and recent news.
segments.tr: Research has consistently shown that views about the economy can vary with political affiliation, media consumption, and recent news.

segments.src: The same data can be read very differently depending on the lens.
segments.tr: The same data can be read very differently depending on the lens.

segments.src: ## Why Expectations Matter for the Fed
segments.tr: ## Why Expectations Matter for the Fed

segments.src: The most closely watched part of the report for policymakers may not be the headline index at all.
segments.tr: The most closely watched part of the report for policymakers may not be the headline index at all.

segments.src: It is the inflation expectations component.
segments.tr: It is the inflation expectations component.

segments.src: Central banks generally believe that what people *expect* inflation to be can influence what inflation actually becomes.
segments.tr: Central banks generally believe that what people *expect* inflation to be can influence what inflation actually becomes.

segments.src: If households expect prices to rise faster, they may push for higher wages, accept price increases more readily, or move purchases forward.
segments.tr: If households expect prices to rise faster, they may push for higher wages, accept price increases more readily, or move purchases forward.

segments.src: Businesses that expect rising costs may raise prices sooner.
segments.tr: Businesses that expect rising costs may raise prices sooner.

segments.src: Over time, these behaviors can make elevated inflation more persistent.
segments.tr: Over time, these behaviors can make elevated inflation more persistent.

segments.src: That is why a move in year-ahead expectations toward 4.6% draws attention.
segments.tr: That is why a move in year-ahead expectations toward 4.6% draws attention.

segments.src: Several caveats apply:
segments.tr: Several caveats apply:

segments.src: - **Short-term expectations are noisy.** Year-ahead figures can swing with gasoline prices and news headlines, and they often overstate where inflation eventually settles.
segments.tr: - **Short-term expectations are noisy.** Year-ahead figures can swing with gasoline prices and news headlines, and they often overstate where inflation eventually settles.

segments.src: - **Longer-term expectations matter more.** The Federal Reserve typically watches whether expectations five to ten years out remain "anchored" near its stated 2% goal. A rise there would be considered more concerning than a short-run jump.
segments.tr: - **Longer-term expectations matter more.** The Federal Reserve typically watches whether expectations five to ten years out remain "anchored" near its stated 2% goal. A rise there would be considered more concerning than a short-run jump.

segments.src: - **Survey and market measures can disagree.** Policymakers compare household surveys with market-based indicators and other surveys of professional forecasters before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: - **Survey and market measures can disagree.** Policymakers compare household surveys with market-based indicators and other surveys of professional forecasters before drawing conclusions.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## What to Watch Next

segments.src: A single monthly reading does not define a trend.
segments.tr: A single monthly reading does not define a trend.

segments.src: Readers who want to understand where sentiment may go from here could keep an eye on:
segments.tr: Readers who want to understand where sentiment may go from here could keep an eye on:

segments.src: 1. **Gasoline and grocery prices**, which tend to feed quickly into household expectations.
segments.tr: 1. **Gasoline and grocery prices**, which tend to feed quickly into household expectations.

segments.src: 2. **Labor market conditions**, since job security is a major driver of confidence.
segments.tr: 2. **Labor market conditions**, since job security is a major driver of confidence.

segments.src: 3. **Longer-run inflation expectations**, which are more important to monetary policy than the one-year figure.
segments.tr: 3. **Longer-run inflation expectations**, which are more important to monetary policy than the one-year figure.

segments.src: 4. **Other confidence gauges**, such as the Conference Board's index, which uses a different methodology and sometimes tells a different story.
segments.tr: 4. **Other confidence gauges**, such as the Conference Board's index, which uses a different methodology and sometimes tells a different story.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## The Bottom Line

segments.src: A sentiment reading near 48 is a signal about how people feel, and feelings are part of the economy.
segments.tr: A sentiment reading near 48 is a signal about how people feel, and feelings are part of the economy.

segments.src: Households that feel pessimistic may spend more cautiously, and expectations that drift higher can complicate the job of those responsible for price stability.
segments.tr: Households that feel pessimistic may spend more cautiously, and expectations that drift higher can complicate the job of those responsible for price stability.

segments.src: At the same time, sentiment is not a forecast, and it has often been a poor predictor of near-term spending.
segments.tr: At the same time, sentiment is not a forecast, and it has often been a poor predictor of near-term spending.

segments.src: The gap between the mood and the data is not necessarily a contradiction.
segments.tr: The gap between the mood and the data is not necessarily a contradiction.

segments.src: It is a reminder that an economy is both a set of statistics and a set of lived experiences, and that policymakers have to take both seriously.
segments.tr: It is a reminder that an economy is both a set of statistics and a set of lived experiences, and that policymakers have to take both seriously.

us-20261010-news-3.title: Mesin Uang Pemilu Sela: Ke Mana Dana Iklan Kampanye Mengalir di Minggu-Minggu Terakhir

segments.src: With Election Day on November 3 less than a month away, the last stretch of the 2026 midterm campaign is also its most expensive.
segments.tr: Dengan Hari Pemilihan pada 3 November yang tinggal kurang dari sebulan lagi, masa-masa terakhir kampanye pemilu sela 2026 juga menjadi masa yang paling mahal.

segments.src: Candidates, party committees and outside groups are all competing for a limited supply of airtime, inbox space and phone screens.
segments.tr: Para kandidat, komite partai, dan kelompok luar semuanya bersaing untuk mendapatkan jatah waktu tayang, ruang kotak masuk, dan layar ponsel yang terbatas.

segments.src: Here is where the money tends to go in the closing weeks, and what those choices reveal about how each side reads the political map.
segments.tr: Berikut adalah ke mana uang cenderung mengalir di minggu-minggu penutupan, dan apa yang diungkapkan oleh pilihan-pilihan tersebut tentang bagaimana masing-masing pihak membaca peta politik.

segments.src: *Note: This article is a general explainer.
segments.tr: *Catatan: Artikel ini adalah penjelasan umum.

segments.src: Spending totals change daily, so check ad-tracking firms and the Federal Election Commission (FEC) for current figures.*
segments.tr: Total pengeluaran berubah setiap hari, jadi periksa perusahaan pelacak iklan dan Komisi Pemilihan Federal (FEC) untuk angka terkini.*

segments.src: ## Why the final weeks cost the most
segments.tr: ## Mengapa minggu-minggu terakhir memakan biaya paling besar

segments.src: Political advertising follows a predictable pattern.
segments.tr: Iklan politik mengikuti pola yang dapat diprediksi.

segments.src: Spending ramps up as Election Day approaches, and the last few weeks are the most crowded.
segments.tr: Pengeluaran meningkat seiring mendekatnya Hari Pemilihan, dan beberapa minggu terakhir adalah yang paling padat.

segments.src: There are a few reasons:
segments.tr: Ada beberapa alasan:

segments.src: - **Voters are paying attention.** Many people tune in only when early voting begins and ballots arrive in the mail.
segments.tr: - **Pemilih mulai memperhatikan.** Banyak orang baru menyimak ketika pemungutan suara awal dimulai dan surat suara tiba di pos.

segments.src: - **Early voting compresses the calendar.** In many states, voting is already underway, so a message has to land before ballots are returned, not just before Election Day.
segments.tr: - **Pemungutan suara awal memadatkan kalender.** Di banyak negara bagian, pemungutan suara sudah berlangsung, jadi pesan harus sampai sebelum surat suara dikembalikan, bukan hanya sebelum Hari Pemilihan.

segments.src: - **Rates rise with demand.** Broadcast stations sell time in a competitive market, and prices tend to climb when many campaigns want the same slots. Federal candidates get legal protections on the rates they pay, but outside groups often pay more.
segments.tr: - **Tarif naik seiring permintaan.** Stasiun siaran menjual waktu di pasar yang kompetitif, dan harga cenderung naik ketika banyak kampanye menginginkan slot yang sama. Kandidat federal mendapatkan perlindungan hukum atas tarif yang mereka bayar, tetapi kelompok luar sering kali membayar lebih.

segments.src: ## Where the dollars go
segments.tr: ## Ke mana uang mengalir

segments.src: ### Broadcast and cable television
segments.tr: ### Televisi siaran dan kabel

segments.src: Local broadcast TV is still the largest single line item in most competitive races.
segments.tr: TV siaran lokal masih menjadi pos pengeluaran tunggal terbesar dalam sebagian besar pemilihan yang kompetitif.

segments.src: It reaches older, high-turnout voters efficiently, and those voters make up a large share of midterm electorates.
segments.tr: Media ini menjangkau pemilih yang lebih tua dengan tingkat partisipasi tinggi secara efisien, dan para pemilih tersebut mencakup sebagian besar dari pemilih pemilu sela.

segments.src: Costs are highest in expensive media markets, and a statewide race in a large state can require buying time in several of them.
segments.tr: Biaya paling tinggi ada di pasar media yang mahal, dan pemilihan tingkat negara bagian di negara bagian yang besar mungkin memerlukan pembelian waktu di beberapa pasar tersebut.

segments.src: ### Streaming and connected TV
segments.tr: ### Streaming dan TV terhubung

segments.src: Connected TV, which includes ads served on streaming services and smart-TV platforms, has become a fast-growing part of campaign budgets.
segments.tr: TV terhubung, yang mencakup iklan yang ditayangkan di layanan streaming dan platform smart-TV, telah menjadi bagian yang tumbuh cepat dalam anggaran kampanye.

segments.src: Its main appeal is targeting.
segments.tr: Daya tarik utamanya adalah penargetan.

segments.src: A campaign can aim at a specific geography or audience instead of paying for every viewer in a market.
segments.tr: Kampanye dapat membidik geografi atau audiens tertentu alih-alih membayar untuk setiap penonton di suatu pasar.

segments.src: Streaming does not replace broadcast, but many strategists now treat it as a complement, especially for reaching viewers who rarely watch live television.
segments.tr: Streaming tidak menggantikan siaran, tetapi banyak ahli strategi sekarang menganggapnya sebagai pelengkap, terutama untuk menjangkau pemirsa yang jarang menonton televisi langsung.

segments.src: ### Digital and social
segments.tr: ### Digital dan sosial

segments.src: Online display, search, video and social ads serve several purposes.
segments.tr: Iklan tampilan online, pencarian, video, dan sosial melayani beberapa tujuan.

segments.src: Some are persuasion messages.
segments.tr: Beberapa adalah pesan persuasi.

segments.src: Others raise money, recruit volunteers or remind supporters how and where to vote.
segments.tr: Yang lain menggalang dana, merekrut sukarelawan, atau mengingatkan pendukung tentang cara dan tempat untuk memilih.

segments.src: Major platforms set their own rules for political ads, including disclosure requirements and, in some cases, restrictions in the final days before an election, so campaigns plan their digital calendars carefully.
segments.tr: Platform utama menetapkan aturan mereka sendiri untuk iklan politik, termasuk persyaratan pengungkapan dan, dalam beberapa kasus, pembatasan di hari-hari terakhir sebelum pemilihan, jadi kampanye merencanakan kalender digital mereka dengan cermat.

segments.src: ### Text, mail and direct outreach
segments.tr: ### Teks, surat, dan penjangkauan langsung

segments.src: Texting, direct mail and phone outreach are less visible than TV but central to turnout efforts.
segments.tr: Pesan teks, surat langsung, dan penjangkauan telepon kurang terlihat dibandingkan TV tetapi sangat penting untuk upaya partisipasi pemilih.

segments.src: In the closing weeks, they are used to provide polling-place information, promote early voting and urge supporters to return mail ballots.
segments.tr: Di minggu-minggu penutupan, sarana ini digunakan untuk memberikan informasi tempat pemungutan suara, mempromosikan pemungutan suara awal, dan mendesak pendukung untuk mengembalikan surat suara.

segments.src: Campaigns must comply with federal and state rules on messaging and consent, and responsible operations build those compliance steps into their programs.
segments.tr: Kampanye harus mematuhi aturan federal dan negara bagian mengenai pesan dan persetujuan, dan operasi yang bertanggung jawab membangun langkah-langkah kepatuhan tersebut ke dalam program mereka.

segments.src: ## Which races absorb the most money
segments.tr: ## Pemilihan mana yang menyerap paling banyak uang

segments.src: Ad money is not spread evenly.
segments.tr: Uang iklan tidak tersebar merata.

segments.src: It concentrates in a small number of contests that are close enough for spending to plausibly change the outcome.
segments.tr: Uang tersebut terkonsentrasi pada sejumlah kecil kontes yang cukup ketat sehingga pengeluaran dapat secara masuk akal mengubah hasil.

segments.src: - **Competitive U.S. Senate races.** Statewide contests in battleground states draw the most spending because they cover multiple media markets and can decide control of the chamber.
segments.tr: - **Pemilihan Senat AS yang kompetitif.** Kontes tingkat negara bagian di negara bagian yang menjadi medan pertempuran menarik pengeluaran paling banyak karena mencakup beberapa pasar media dan dapat menentukan kendali atas majelis tersebut.

segments.src: - **Governor's races.** Open seats and tight contests in large states can produce enormous ad budgets.
segments.tr: - **Pemilihan Gubernur.** Kursi yang kosong dan kontes ketat di negara bagian besar dapat menghasilkan anggaran iklan yang sangat besar.

segments.src: - **Key U.S. House districts.** Control of the House typically turns on a few dozen competitive seats. Party committees and affiliated super PACs often spend heavily in those districts, particularly in expensive markets such as the New York and Los Angeles areas, where TV costs are high.
segments.tr: - **Distrik DPR AS yang utama.** Kendali atas DPR biasanya bergantung pada beberapa lusin kursi yang kompetitif. Komite partai dan super PAC yang berafiliasi sering menghabiskan banyak uang di distrik-distrik tersebut, terutama di pasar yang mahal seperti wilayah New York dan Los Angeles, di mana biaya TV tinggi.

segments.src: - **Ballot measures.** In some states, referendums and initiatives on issues such as taxes, abortion access or election rules attract eight-figure campaigns of their own.
segments.tr: - **Tindakan pemungutan suara.** Di beberapa negara bagian, referendum dan inisiatif mengenai isu-isu seperti pajak, akses aborsi, atau aturan pemilihan menarik kampanye bernilai delapan digit.

segments.src: ## What the spending says about the map
segments.tr: ## Apa yang dikatakan pengeluaran tentang peta politik

segments.src: Strategists often say that where a group puts its money is the clearest signal of what it believes.
segments.tr: Ahli strategi sering mengatakan bahwa ke mana suatu kelompok menempatkan uangnya adalah sinyal paling jelas tentang apa yang mereka yakini.

segments.src: Reading the spending patterns can offer a few clues.
segments.tr: Membaca pola pengeluaran dapat memberikan beberapa petunjuk.

segments.src: **Defense versus offense.** When a party or allied group books time in a district it usually wins, it is typically playing defense and worried about erosion there.
segments.tr: **Pertahanan versus serangan.** Ketika sebuah partai atau kelompok sekutu memesan waktu di distrik yang biasanya mereka menangkan, mereka biasanya bermain bertahan dan khawatir tentang erosi di sana.

segments.src: Money in territory the other side holds suggests confidence that the seat is within reach.
segments.tr: Uang di wilayah yang dikuasai pihak lain menunjukkan keyakinan bahwa kursi tersebut dapat diraih.

segments.src: Shifts from week to week, such as a group canceling reservations in one race and adding them in another, are closely watched as a sign of internal polling.
segments.tr: Pergeseran dari minggu ke minggu, seperti kelompok yang membatalkan reservasi dalam satu pemilihan dan menambahkannya di pemilihan lain, diawasi dengan ketat sebagai tanda jajak pendapat internal.

segments.src: **Expanding or shrinking the battlefield.** Late reservations in a race that was not on the radar months ago suggest the map is widening.
segments.tr: **Memperluas atau mempersempit medan pertempuran.** Reservasi terlambat dalam pemilihan yang tidak ada dalam radar beberapa bulan lalu menunjukkan peta sedang melebar.

segments.src: Pulled reservations may mean a campaign has concluded a race is either safe or out of reach.
segments.tr: Reservasi yang ditarik mungkin berarti kampanye telah menyimpulkan bahwa suatu pemilihan sudah aman atau di luar jangkauan.

segments.src: **The role of outside groups.** Super PACs and other outside organizations can raise large sums and often fill gaps that candidate committees cannot, particularly because candidates and parties have contribution limits that outside groups do not.
segments.tr: **Peran kelompok luar.** Super PAC dan organisasi luar lainnya dapat mengumpulkan dana besar dan sering kali mengisi celah yang tidak bisa diisi oleh komite kandidat, terutama karena kandidat dan partai memiliki batas kontribusi yang tidak dimiliki kelompok luar.

segments.src: Some of these groups disclose donors; others, such as certain nonprofits, have more limited disclosure.
segments.tr: Beberapa dari kelompok ini mengungkapkan donor; yang lain, seperti organisasi nirlaba tertentu, memiliki pengungkapan yang lebih terbatas.

segments.src: That is one reason transparency advocates keep a close eye on the final-month filings.
segments.tr: Itulah salah satu alasan mengapa advokat transparansi terus memantau pengajuan laporan bulan terakhir.

segments.src: **Candidate fundraising strength.** In some races, one candidate has a clear fundraising advantage.
segments.tr: **Kekuatan penggalangan dana kandidat.** Dalam beberapa pemilihan, satu kandidat memiliki keunggulan penggalangan dana yang jelas.

segments.src: In others, the candidate who is behind on money is helped by party or outside spending that narrows the gap on the air.
segments.tr: Dalam pemilihan lain, kandidat yang tertinggal dalam hal uang dibantu oleh pengeluaran partai atau pihak luar yang mempersempit kesenjangan di media.

segments.src: ## What viewers and voters should know
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus diketahui pemirsa dan pemilih

segments.src: - **Check the disclaimer.** Federal ads must state who paid for them. "Paid for by..." and "I approve this message" lines show whether an ad came from a candidate, a party committee or an outside group.
segments.tr: - **Periksa penafian.** Iklan federal harus menyatakan siapa yang membayarnya. Baris "Dibayar oleh..." dan "Saya menyetujui pesan ini" menunjukkan apakah iklan berasal dari kandidat, komite partai, atau kelompok luar.

segments.src: - **Look up the sponsor.** The FEC database and state election offices publish campaign finance reports, and independent trackers publish ad-spending data.
segments.tr: - **Cari sponsornya.** Basis data FEC dan kantor pemilihan negara bagian menerbitkan laporan keuangan kampanye, dan pelacak independen menerbitkan data pengeluaran iklan.

segments.src: - **Remember that an ad is advocacy.** Campaign ads are designed to persuade. Claims about opponents are often selective, and fact-checking organizations and nonpartisan voter guides can help provide context.
segments.tr: - **Ingat bahwa iklan adalah advokasi.** Iklan kampanye dirancang untuk membujuk. Klaim tentang lawan sering kali selektif, dan organisasi pemeriksa fakta serta panduan pemilih nonpartisan dapat membantu memberikan konteks.

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote.** Rules on early voting, mail ballots and registration deadlines vary by state. Your state or local election office is the most reliable source for dates and locations.
segments.tr: - **Buat rencana untuk memilih.** Aturan tentang pemungutan suara awal, surat suara, dan tenggat waktu pendaftaran bervariasi menurut negara bagian. Kantor pemilihan negara bagian atau lokal Anda adalah sumber yang paling dapat diandalkan untuk tanggal dan lokasi.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: The late-campaign surge in political advertising is a reminder that elections are shaped by both messages and logistics.
segments.tr: Lonjakan iklan politik di akhir kampanye adalah pengingat bahwa pemilihan dibentuk oleh pesan dan logistik.

segments.src: Which markets get ads, which screens are targeted and which races attract outside money all reflect each side's view of where the next majority will be won or lost.
segments.tr: Pasar mana yang mendapatkan iklan, layar mana yang ditargetkan, dan pemilihan mana yang menarik uang dari luar, semuanya mencerminkan pandangan masing-masing pihak tentang di mana mayoritas berikutnya akan dimenangkan atau dikalahkan.

segments.src: By Election Day, the spending map will say a lot about what campaigns believed was in play, even before the votes are counted.
segments.tr: Menjelang Hari Pemilihan, peta pengeluaran akan banyak bercerita tentang apa yang diyakini oleh kampanye, bahkan sebelum suara dihitung.
